parent_objective: design support-first measured-runner adapter before any measured rollout
blocked_by: M1871 finds that existing measured runners do not directly consume support-first payload semantics
supersedes: direct measured execution from support-first reset payload
using support-first profile_name as controller profile_name

public_gates: M1872 must define the support-first measured-runner adapter schema without running rollout
M1872 must separate scenario_profile_name from controller_profile_name
M1872 must choose full-matrix or smoke-matrix execution budget and profile set without tuning
M1872 must preserve the support-first role-surface imbalance explicitly
M1872 must define role-wise diagnostic outputs and keep ranking paper-level and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat support-first profile_name as a controller policy profile

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the adapter contract needed to convert reset-validated support-first specs into measured workload rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: runner-adapter design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if scenario profile and controller profile semantics cannot be separated
stop if no bounded execution budget can preserve all support-first roles
stop if the design hides the unavoidable post-friction role-surface shortage
stop if the design admits ranking or paper-level claims
fallback_plan: route to adapter implementation if schema and budget are explicit
route to source-balance repair if imbalance blocks diagnostic measured execution
route to runner compatibility audit if existing shared rollout helpers cannot support the adapter
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1871 measured execution design requires an adapter before rollout

admission_evidence: M1871 identifies direct measured runner incompatibility and routes to adapter design
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1872 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for adapter implementation or repair
next_stage_criteria: scenario_profile_name and controller_profile_name separation is explicit
workload counts and profile set are explicit
role-wise metrics and imbalance handling are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; runner-adapter design is task-quality infrastructure.
history_necessity_tests: Design must preserve controller profile identity for later current-response/finite-window/GRU comparisons.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1869 reset rows only; no rollout in design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If support-first measured execution cannot be designed cleanly, route to adapter repair or source-balance repair rather than weakening evidence standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A support-first measured-runner adapter can be designed by separating scenario-profile metadata from controller policy profiles while preserving role-wise diagnostics and blocking ranking claims.
success_criteria: design defines adapter input schema and output workload schema
design chooses execution budget and profile set without tuning
design blocks ranking paper-level and level3 self-ID claims
no measured rollout training replay PPO or ranking is run
failure_criteria: design runs rollout or policy actions
design conflates support-first profile_name with controller policy profile_name
design routes directly to controller ranking
design changes actor inputs reward dynamics or termination behavior

result.known_imbalance: unavoidable_mitigation::post_friction_step has 12 rows while most role-surfaces have 24

decision_rule: M1872 passes if it defines the adapter schema, workload budget, role-wise outputs, and claim boundaries without running rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
